title: Chronicle Scenario Manifest
description: Author-facing scenario manifest loaded from scenario.json for the v1 scenario package contract.

id.description: Stable scenario package ID, chosen by the package author. Shared cartridges should avoid whitespace and path separators.

version.description: Scenario cartridge content version, independent of Chronicle's schema version. A simple semantic version such as 1.0.0 is recommended.

files.description: Relative paths to all package data files. Paths must stay inside the package directory.

metadata.description: Optional string-to-string cartridge metadata. Shared cartridges should include description, author, and license.
